snippet.title: Eternity’s End – Launch Trailer | World of Warcraft: Shadowlands
snippet.description:
The Jailer now holds the key to forging a new reality where all souls kneel in his service. In a final stand, Azeroth’s heroes must pursue him into the mysterious realm of Zereth Mortis, where the Progenitors first forged the afterlives. Stand together in the Shadowlands’ darkest hour and defy Death to decide the fate of the cosmos before all you know is undone. 

Learn more at http://WorldofWarcraft.com
